ITEM.PTXT: With ACC ON or IG ON, when the outer mirror switch is locked in the pushed-in position <protruding position>, the retract side switch <return side switch> turns ON, and current flows to the retract/return motor via the retract/return circuit (motor lock current detection circuit), operating the motor.
When the mirror moves to the retracted position <return position> and the retract/return circuit detects motor lock, the circuit cuts off the current and the retract/return motor stops.
